commits.author: Parker Mauney
commits.message:
build(plugin): Activate gradle repos by submodule (#89)

This removes the "gradle-build" profile used to add repositories for the
gradle-plugin submodule, and instead declares the repositories directly.
The profile only affects a single independent submodule that will fail
to build unless the profile is active, so it seems redundant.

commits.author: Nándor Holozsnyák
commits.message:
feat(core): Templates with optional environment variable property format #37 (#43)

* feat(core): Templates with optional environment variable property format

- Downgrading Spring Boot version to make sure the used classes are working on Java 11 too.
- Using the new `as_env` helper with the help of the `include_env_format` helper
- Feature is hidden behind a new configuration key that can be used with the maven plugin
- Generation date can be turned of via a new configuration key
- New XSD for the XML template
- IT tests for the generation parts
- Documentation updates
- JBang script is not updated with the changes (yet)
- TemplateData interface implementations now must implement get and set template customization to make sure the Handlebars templates can use the new helpers in the aggregated forms as well.
- AggregationDocumenterIT introduced
- Extended NPE check in the IncludeEnvironmentVariableFormatHelper
- Marking spring-boot dependency in the pom.xml as compile scope
